latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Podcast Producer — an all-in-one tool for transforming raw podcast transcripts into publish-ready content.

- Generates five outputs: episode titles, show notes, chapter timestamps, social captions, and SEO tags from any podcast transcript.
- Supports both AI-narrated (documentary style) and human hosted (conversational style) podcasts, with guidance for writing and tone based on mode.
- Automatically detects transcript input as text or file; prompts for missing input or style selection.
- Provides platform-specific social media captions and structured SEO tags for enhanced discoverability.
- Handles edge cases (short transcript, language detection, missing style) with user prompts or sensible defaults.
